Stage both retained blocks away from the base so the displaced long board can be repaired without another collision. Keep grippers closed during transport.
Release the staged blocks near the table and withdraw vertically. The long board has settled onto its supports but is skewed; inspect before recentering it.

Center each board end between the fingers using the wrist views, close both grippers, and make a small matched retention-test lift.
Lift the retained board clear of the supports, translate left to their midpoint, and correct its small yaw with matched end motion.

Move both retained blocks inward at safe clearance to a symmetric pair above the lower board, keeping their upright orientation.

Carry the retained middle board forward over the supports, correcting the small end-height mismatch and centering it over the lower layer.
